slides.title: Morning Golf
slides.body: Tour, LPGA, DP World Tour, and Champions Tour all tee off at 12:00 AM ET. Watch on ESPN, ESPN+, CBS, and Golf Channel.

slides.title: Afternoon Soccer
slides.body: La Liga, Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, and more hit the afternoon window. Check ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, Paramount+, and USA Network.

slides.title: MLB Spotlight
slides.body: Reds-Cubs at 2:20 PM ET, then Dodgers-Tigers and Marlins-Nationals in the evening. Watch on MLB.TV and team networks.

slides.title: Prime Time NFL
slides.body: Commanders-Ravens at 6:00 PM ET on NFL Network. Falcons-Dolphins follow at 7:00 PM ET on CBS Miami.

slides.title: Follow For Daily Schedules
slides.body: Get the full day’s watch guide, updated daily. Follow @any_and_all_sports for more sports schedules.
